title: Has anyone seen this place I describe?
content: Has anyone been to a place in their dreams where it's like a small chapel/ritual spot/tiny, old town square (from what i remember) that is in the middle of what I can best describe as a crater or crevass, and surrounding it, very high up on the edges of a circular/surrounding cliff, there are dilapidated and abandoned houses that belonged to (i think) witches, and some were hanged for witch craft? Its eerie and silent. The only thing you hear is the wind blowing. I've had 2 dreams there so far and they're so vivid, it seems like a real place (like mall world). I even toured the houses because they were trying to rent them out. Is this a place anyone has dreamt about too?
